tasks.name: 向量补全
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 向量维护任务 — 增量构建 + 孤儿向量补全 (弹窗版)
// 手动触发：interval=0，勾选"按钮激活"
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 设计：
//  1) 阶段一不再调 buildIncrementalChunks（它把全部待建楼层塞进单个
//     embed 请求，楼层多时 >30s 超时被掐断 AbortError，且内部吞错）。
//  2) L1 文本由 chunkMessage 自己生成 + saveChunks 保存（不 embed），
//     不再依赖被删的入口，长期维护不会缺 chunks。
//  3) 所有向量统一走阶段二分批补缺（20/批 + 30s 退避重试）。
//  4) L0 保留 incrementalExtractAtoms（锚点需 LLM 提取生成）。
//  5) 全部导入集中在顶部一次，避免重复声明报错。

const BASE = '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary';

// =====================================================
// 工具：UI 弹窗封装
// =====================================================
const toast = (msg, type = 'info', short = false) => {
  console.log(`[向量维护] ${msg}`);
  if (typeof toastr !== 'undefined') {
    toastr[type](msg, '向量维护', {
      timeOut: short ? 1500 : 4000,
      preventDuplicates: true,
      positionClass: 'toast-top-right'
    });
  }
};

// 1. 获取上下文
const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
const { chatId, chat } = getContext();
if (!chatId) return toast('❌ 未打开聊天', 'warning');

// 2. 获取向量配置
const { getVectorConfig } = await import(`${BASE}/data/config.js`);
const vectorCfg = getVectorConfig();
if (!vectorCfg?.enabled || !vectorCfg.embeddingApi?.key) {
  return toast('❌ 向量检索未启用或未配置 API Key', 'warning');
}

// 3. 加载依赖（每个模块只 import 一次，同一模块的导出集中解构）
const [
  { getAllChunks, getAllChunkVectors, saveChunkVectors, saveChunks, getAllEventVectors, saveEventVectors, getMeta, updateMeta },
  { getStateAtoms, getAllStateVectors, saveStateVectors },
  { embed, getEngineFingerprint },
  { getSummaryStore },
  { incrementalExtractAtoms },
  { chunkMessage }
] = await Promise.all([
  import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/chunk-store.js`),
  import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/state-store.js`),
  import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/embedder.js`),
  import(`${BASE}/data/store.js`),
  import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-integration.js`),
  import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-builder.js`)
]);

const fingerprint = getEngineFingerprint(vectorCfg);
const BATCH = 20;
const R_AGG_MAX_CHARS = 256;
const EMBED_RETRY_WAIT_S = 30;

// 兼容酒馆的 setTimeoutSafe
const delay = (ms) => new Promise(r => (typeof setTimeoutSafe === 'function' ? setTimeoutSafe : setTimeout)(r, ms));

// =====================================================
// 工具：embed 带重试
// =====================================================
async function embedWithRetry(texts, label, maxRetries = 2) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await embed(texts, vectorCfg);
    } catch (e) {
      if (attempt === maxRetries) throw e;
      const wait = EMBED_RETRY_WAIT_S;
      toast(`⚠️ ${label} embed 失败，${wait}s 后重试 (${attempt + 1}/${maxRetries})`, 'warning');
      for (let s = wait; s > 0; s--) await delay(1000);
    }
  }
}

function buildRText(atom) {
  const uniq = new Set();
  for (const edge of (atom?.edges || [])) {
    const r = String(edge?.r || '').trim();
    if (r) uniq.add(r);
  }
  const joined = [...uniq].join(' ; ');
  if (!joined) return String(atom?.semantic || '').trim();
  return joined.length > R_AGG_MAX_CHARS ? joined.slice(0, R_AGG_MAX_CHARS) : joined;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 阶段一：L0 锚点增量提取 + L1 文本生成（不 embed）
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
toast('🚀 开始阶段一：L0 锚点增量提取 + L1 文本生成...', 'info');

try {
  // L0 锚点提取（LLM 提取 + 分批向量化，自愈正常）
  const l0IncResult = await incrementalExtractAtoms(chatId, chat, (msg) => {
    toast(`L0 提取进度: ${msg}`, 'info', true);
  }, { maxFloors: Infinity });

  if (l0IncResult?.cancelled) {
    toast('⏹️ L0 提取被取消', 'warning');
  } else if ((l0IncResult?.built || 0) > 0) {
    toast(`✅ L0 增量提取完成，新增 ${l0IncResult.built} 个锚点`, 'success');
  } else {
    toast('ℹ️ L0 进度已是最新', 'info', true);
  }

  // L1：自己生成新楼层 chunks 文本（不 embed，向量交给阶段二补缺）
  const meta = await getMeta(chatId);
  const startFloor = (meta?.lastChunkFloor ?? -1) + 1;
  if (startFloor < (chat?.length || 0)) {
    const newChunks = [];
    for (let f = startFloor; f < chat.length; f++) {
      if (chat[f]?.mes?.trim()) newChunks.push(...chunkMessage(f, chat[f]));
    }
    if (newChunks.length) {
      await saveChunks(chatId, newChunks);
      toast(`✅ L1: 已生成 ${newChunks.length} 个新片段文本`, 'success');
    } else {
      await updateMeta(chatId, { lastChunkFloor: chat.length - 1 });
    }
  } else {
    toast('ℹ️ L1 进度已是最新', 'info', true);
  }
} catch (e) {
  toast(`⚠️ 阶段一异常（已跳过，继续阶段二）: ${e.message}`, 'warning');
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// 阶段二：孤儿向量补全（修复已有文本但缺向量的残次品）
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
toast('🛠️ 开始阶段二：孤儿向量补全...', 'info');

try {
  // =====================================================
  // L1: chunk 向量补全（20/批）
  // =====================================================
  const [allChunks, allChunkVectors] = await Promise.all([
    getAllChunks(chatId),
    getAllChunkVectors(chatId),
  ]);
  const chunkIdSet = new Set(allChunkVectors.map(v => v.chunkId));
  const missingL1 = allChunks.filter(c => c?.chunkId && c?.text && !chunkIdSet.has(c.chunkId));

  let l1Fixed = 0;
  if (missingL1.length > 0) {
    toast(`🔍 L1: 发现 ${missingL1.length} 个孤儿片段，开始修复...`, 'warning');
    for (let i = 0; i < missingL1.length; i += BATCH) {
      const batch = missingL1.slice(i, i + BATCH);
      const vecs = await embedWithRetry(batch.map(c => c.text), 'L1');
      await saveChunkVectors(chatId,
        batch.map((c, j) => ({ chunkId: c.chunkId, vector: vecs[j] })),
        fingerprint);
      l1Fixed += batch.length;
      toast(`L1 修复中: ${Math.min(i + BATCH, missingL1.length)}/${missingL1.length}`, 'info', true);
    }
    toast(`✅ L1: 修复完成 (${l1Fixed})`, 'success');
  } else {
    toast('ℹ️ L1: 无孤儿片段', 'info', true);
  }

  // ★ 推进边界，让面板 L1 进度与实际向量一致
  await updateMeta(chatId, { lastChunkFloor: (chat?.length || 1) - 1 });

  // =====================================================
  // L2: event 向量补全
  // =====================================================
  const store = getSummaryStore();
  const events = (store && store.json && Array.isArray(store.json.events)) ? store.json.events : [];
  const allEventVectors = await getAllEventVectors(chatId);
  const eventIdSet = new Set(allEventVectors.map(v => v.eventId));

  const missingL2 = events.filter(e => {
    if (!e?.id || eventIdSet.has(e.id)) return false;
    const text = `${e?.title || ''} ${e?.summary || ''}`.trim();
    return text.length > 0;
  });

  let l2Fixed = 0;
  if (missingL2.length > 0) {
    toast(`🔍 L2: 发现 ${missingL2.length} 个孤儿事件，开始修复...`, 'warning');
    for (let i = 0; i < missingL2.length; i += BATCH) {
      const batch = missingL2.slice(i, i + BATCH);
      const texts = batch.map(e => `${e?.title || ''} ${e?.summary || ''}`.trim());
      const vecs = await embedWithRetry(texts, 'L2');
      await saveEventVectors(chatId,
        batch.map((e, j) => ({ eventId: e.id, vector: vecs[j] })),
        fingerprint);
      l2Fixed += batch.length;
    }
    toast(`✅ L2: 修复完成 (${l2Fixed})`, 'success');
  }

  // =====================================================
  // L0: state 向量补全（含 r-vector）
  // =====================================================
  const atoms = getStateAtoms();
  const allStateVectors = await getAllStateVectors(chatId);
  const stateIdSet = new Set(allStateVectors.map(v => String(v.atomId)));
  const missingL0 = atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId && !stateIdSet.has(String(a.atomId)) && a?.semantic);

  let l0Fixed = 0;
  if (missingL0.length > 0) {
    toast(`🔍 L0: 发现 ${missingL0.length} 个孤儿锚点，开始修复...`, 'warning');
    for (let i = 0; i < missingL0.length; i += BATCH) {
      const batch = missingL0.slice(i, i + BATCH);
      const semTexts = batch.map(a => a.semantic);
      const rTexts = batch.map(a => buildRText(a));

      const payload = semTexts.concat(rTexts);
      const vecs = await embedWithRetry(payload, 'L0');
      const split = semTexts.length;

      const semVectors = vecs.slice(0, split);
      const rVectors = vecs.slice(split, split + split);

      await saveStateVectors(chatId,
        batch.map((a, j) => ({
          atomId: a.atomId,
          floor: a.floor,
          vector: semVectors[j],
          rVector: rVectors[j] || semVectors[j]
        })),
        fingerprint);
      l0Fixed += batch.length;
    }
    toast(`✅ L0: 修复完成 (${l0Fixed})`, 'success');
  }

  // 汇总
  const total = (l1Fixed || 0) + (l2Fixed || 0) + (l0Fixed || 0);
  toast(total > 0 ? `🎉 全部向量维护完成，共修复 ${total} 条` : '🎉 全部向量维护完成，无缺口', 'success');
} catch (e) {
  toast(`❌ 阶段二发生异常: ${e.message}`, 'error');
}
<</taskjs>>
